Satellite name Compass-1 (Compass 1)

NORAD ID 32787
Deployer XPOD (eXperimental Push Out Deployer) [UTIAS/SFL]
Launcher PSLV
Entity name Aachen University of Applied Sciences
Institution University
Entity type Academic / Education
Country Germany
Launch brokerer Space Flight Laboratory (UTIAS-SFL)
Oneliner

Demonstrate CubeSat platform technologies for educational purposes and GPS receiver. Camera to take photos.
Description

To take color images of the earth at a resolution of 640x480 pixels, to validate (test) a Phoenix GPS receiver from DLR in orbit, to test three-axis attitude control (based on magnetic actuation), and to verify the functionality of the spacecraft in space (technology demonstration).
